title: Feedback session with Westbrook engineering study groups
text:
Tomas Rivera (campus ambassador) runs a feedback session with 8 students from the engineering study groups. Wop joins by video.

Questions to ask:
- How did the "exam cram" study style work before midterms?
- Is a group of 5 too big for problem sets?
- Would you book a library study room from the app?
- Any problems with notifications or slow screens on Android?

Tomas will send a summary by email afterwards.
